description: Traffic Services Maintenance - Striping, Signs, Signals, and Guardrail Maintenance is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. A letter grade is used to rate traffic services. This maintenance program ensures that stripes on traffic lanes are clearly marked, highway signs are visible, traffic signals are functioning properly and guardrails are intact and functioning. Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are striping, signs, signals, maintenance, guardrail. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: CDOT - Department of Transportation. The portal shows 2014-03-27 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
